title: Do LLMs Experience an Internal Polylogue? Investigating Reasoning through the Lens of Personas
abstract: arXiv:2605.09159v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) encode behavioural traits ("personas") as linear directions in activation space, often called "persona vectors". Prior work has used such directions as static handles for behavioural steering. We instead treat them as dynamic signals: probes we can monitor and intervene on as reasoning unfolds. We use the term polylogue to denote the time series of alignments between persona vectors and hidden activations over the course of generation. Experiments across four open-weight models show that polylogue features predict correctness on MMLU-Pro on par with low-dimensional activation baselines, while remaining interpretable through their associated persona directions. They also suggest concrete steering targets, namely which latent directions to modulate at different stages of a response. translated_title: 大语言模型会经历内部多重对话吗？通过人格视角研究推理
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，大语言模型将行为特征（即“人格”）编码为激活空间中的线性方向，通常被称为“人格向量”。以往的工作将这些方向用作行为引导的静态抓手，而我们则将其视为动态信号：即在推理展开过程中可被监控和干预的探针。我们使用“多重对话”这一术语来表示在生成过程中人格向量与隐藏激活之间对齐的时间序列。在四个开源权重模型上的实验表明，多重对话特征在预测MMLU-Pro上的答案正确性方面与低维激活基线相当，同时仍可通过其关联的人格方向保持可解释性。这些特征还指出了具体的引导目标，即应在回答的不同阶段调节哪些潜在方向。我们将其实例化为一种简单的基于段落条件的干预方法，该方法在四个模型中的三个上提升了准确率……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文创新性地将“人格向量”从静态引导工具转变为动态可监控信号，通过追踪其与隐藏激活在生成过程中的对齐序列（“多重对话”）来预测推理正确性，并据此设计分段干预方法提升模型在MMLU-Pro上的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper repurposes persona vectors from static steering tools into dynamic, monitorable signals, tracking their alignment with hidden activations over generation ("polylogue") to predict reasoning correctness and guide paragraph-conditioned interventions that improve MMLU-Pro accuracy.
